novelty_flags.label: Flagship kernel: Open-ended Questions 1–2
novelty_flags.one_line: The related-work survey omits FeirLemieuxMarmer2016, the direct known-cutoff weak-identification fuzzy-RD confidence-set predecessor; add and distinguish it from the unknown-cutoff minimax problem.

soundness_flags.label: ass:observable-association-separation
soundness_flags.one_line: The condition is not a standard fuzzy-RD regularity condition under the cited NoackRothe2024 label; its uniform conditional correlation restriction must be retagged novel and independently motivated, or removed.

soundness_flags.label: ass:observable-association-separation
soundness_flags.one_line: A support-wide exclusion of near-perfect treatment–outcome association is load-bearing for calibration but has no application-specific justification, despite the proposal's association-robust framing.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2 (all-strength-profile)
soundness_flags.one_line: “Whenever cutoff recovery is information-theoretically possible” is undefined, so the asserted outside-critical-face rate lacks a determinate domain; state the recovery predicate and its regime conditions in T_n, tau_n, s, and kappa_n.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Add Feir, Lemieux, and Marmer (2016) to related work and explicitly state that its null-restricted weak-FRD confidence sets retain a known cutoff, whereas this project introduces cutoff uncertainty and minimax connected-length loss.

Either remove the conditional-association separation and formulate joint-score calibration valid up to deterministic D–Y association, or retag it as novel and give an empirical/design justification plus a theorem showing exactly why it is necessary.
Replace the undefined recovery qualifier in Open-ended Question 2 with explicit sequence regimes and a formal predicate, then state which regime receives L_n^star asymp r_n.

Provide a small finite-grid worked profile instance exhibiting the proposed joint four-cell calibration and its fallback branches, so the all-strength construction is concretely auditable before the full asymptotic proof.
